name: Displate Artist Upload Requirements (2026)
source_hierarchy: Displate Upload Preparation / HD Print Quality page
Current Displate Artist FAQ / technical requirements
Current applicable Displate Terms of Use

minimum_short_side_px.description: Minimum shortest image side required for Displate marketplace approval

target_aspect_ratio.description: Target artwork aspect ratio (1.4:1 / 5:7) for standard metal canvas fit

minimum_dpi.description: Minimum print resolution metadata required (300 DPI or higher)

reference_safe_margin_px.description: Official 200px edge reference for the minimum-size 4060x2900 file; not a universal scaled mandate

preferred_output_color_profile.description: Recommended color profile for standardized output normalization; AdobeRGB (1998) is also accepted in source files

preferred_output_format.description: Preferred standard output format for upload preparation

aspect_ratio_comparison_epsilon.description: Internal floating-point computational comparison tolerance; NOT an official Displate tolerance

brightness_dark_threshold.description: Internal heuristic threshold for flagging very dark compositions; not an official Displate threshold

border_sample_px.description: Internal heuristic sampling band thickness for edge border detection

border_difference_threshold.description: Internal color distance threshold for possible artificial border detection

noise_flat_threshold.description: Internal standard deviation threshold for clean patch heuristic

noise_warn_std.description: Internal standard deviation threshold for heavy noise heuristic

upscale_var_threshold.description: Internal local variance threshold for detecting possible artificial upscaling

upscale_edge_threshold.description: Internal edge density threshold for detecting possible artificial upscaling

sharp_ratio_threshold.description: Internal ratio of edge RMS to blurred edge RMS for over-sharpening halo detection

sharp_abs_threshold.description: Internal absolute edge RMS threshold for over-sharpening flag

edge_content_abs.description: Internal absolute edge density in border strip for safe margin advisory

edge_content_ratio.description: Internal edge density ratio (strip vs center) for safe margin advisory

phash_distance_threshold.description: Internal Hamming distance threshold for local pHash near-duplicate detection

flat_area_ratio_threshold.description: Area ratio threshold (15%) above which a flat surface advisory warning is issued

flat_variance_threshold.description: Local patch standard deviation threshold below which a region is considered flat

flat_edge_density_threshold.description: Edge density threshold below which a region lacks structural edges

flat_min_region_pixels.description: Minimum connected flat patch pixel count on analysis copy to ignore small details

flat_edge_protection_distance.description: Edge protection exclusion distance in pixels on analysis copy to fade out texture near edges

flat_detection_max_px.description: Maximum dimension for analysis copy when computing flat mask

texture_enabled_default.description: Default state for texture enhancement (disabled by default)

texture_amplitudes.description: Relative luminance amplitudes for subtle print micro-texture
